expectedUsable: Each order's status (delivered / in transit / problem) is conveyed by text (or an accessible name), not by the colour of a dot alone.

violations.expectedFix: Add a text label alongside each dot (e.g. "Delivered", "In transit", "Delayed") or give the indicator an accessible name/aria-label conveying the status. Colour must not be the only means.
violations.notes: The status cell contains only a coloured <span>. Contrast is fine and there is no non-text-content rule to trip, so axe is clean. Use of Colour (1.4.1) has no reliable automated axe test; Layer C flags that the status carries meaning by colour alone with no text alternative.
